editorialSummary.heading: Hardee's homecoming holiday, early releases and Good Friday
highlights: October 2 is a full homecoming/fall holiday for students and staff.
Students return March 22 after spring break, then have Good Friday off March 26.
May 27 ends the fourth quarter with student early release; May 28 is a teacher post day.
paragraphs: Hardee's homecoming/fall holiday on October 2 is a full day off for students and staff. September 18 and October 14 are also student-free days for staff inservice.

Thanksgiving break runs November 21–29. Winter break is December 19–January 3, but January 4 is a records day without student classes. Students return January 5. In March, students return from spring break on March 22 and have classes scheduled through March 25 before the separate Good Friday holiday on March 26.
Progress reports are scheduled for September 14 and November 11, 2026, then February 5 and April 21, 2027. Report cards are scheduled for October 21, 2026, and January 14, March 31 and May 26, 2027.

Graduation is scheduled for Saturday, May 22, 2027. The fourth quarter ends May 27 with student early release, followed by a teacher post day on May 28. Together, those dates indicate May 27 is the final regular student day, although the PDF does not explicitly call it the last day of school. Summer school is listed separately for June 1–30, with individual attendance days and hours not specified.

The five early-release dates are November 20 and December 18, 2026, and February 19, March 12 and May 27, 2027. February 19 is a shortened student day before staff inservice, not a full day off. The district PDF does not give dismissal times, so families should confirm their school's pickup schedule.

about.processing: The PDF was inspected as text and a rendered page. Current calendar-page content was read on the district-linked hardeefl.sites.thrillshare.com host after direct custom-domain DNS failures; it contains the same short PDF link and the academic-date table. The September 18 Staff Inservice and January 4 Records Day events are explicitly categorized No School for STUDENTS in the page’s structured calendar content. October 2 states No Students/No Staff, overriding an additional generic Early Release filter on the online occurrence; it is a full closure, not a shortened school day. February 19 combines student early release with staff inservice and remains attendance. The first-quarter end October 8 is not an early-release date. November 11 is a progress-report date with no holiday marking; no Veterans Day closure is inferred. Thanksgiving November 21-29, Winter Break December 19-January 3 and Spring Break March 13-21 retain their printed weekend-inclusive ranges. January 4 remains separate and January 5 is an explicit return. March 22-25 are not bridged into Good Friday March 26. May 27 has one canonical fourth-quarter-end/early-release occurrence; its CALENDAR_END classification and finalStudentDate are derived from that entry and May 28 Teacher Post Day. Graduation on Saturday May 22 does not establish regular Saturday classes or a separate senior last day. Regular attendance is calculated as 208 weekdays minus 28 confirmed no-school weekdays = 180; the PDF does not print an annual student-day total. The five shortened dates count once each. Report-card grades-due dates October 15, January 8, March 25 and May 20 are staff deadlines and are excluded; issued dates October 21, January 14, March 31 and May 26 are retained. August employee start/inservice/professional days, May 28 post day, July 3 and May 31 employee/after-year holidays are excluded. The six school-specific open-house entries have separate audience/time sources and do not create class days. Summer school June 1-30 is a program window with no attendance flags or invented weekly meeting pattern; June 18 Juneteenth is scoped to that program and excluded from regular-year closure statistics. Neither early-release bell times nor summer hours were verified. Old 2025-2026 feed items about a May 28 last day or March 13 dismissal at 1 p.m. are not evidence for 2026-2027. A historical alert saying staff return Monday October 14 is not a 2026 calendar revision; October 14, 2026 is Wednesday. PDF export metadata does not establish a publication/revision date. Open-house occurrences use the OPEN_HOUSE category without implying an evening event; their published campus, grade and surname time groups are retained.
about.updates: Verified October 19, 2026. Current Calendar, News and Live Feed content was checked on the district’s linked Apptegy host. The October 8 district post confirms no students October 14. No later confirmed attendance change, current early-release clock time or designated weather make-up reserve list was verified. The district Live Feed still provides the six-campus open-house notice, its registration reminder and the October 14 student-closure notice. These notices establish published arrangements, not independent confirmation that each past event took place. It lists May 26 for the fourth-quarter end and student early release, May 27 for Teacher Post Day, April 14 for progress reports and May 25 for final report cards; these are historical differences, not current dates. The August 13 PDF remains the current attendance source. No cause is assigned to a third-party website’s different date. The six-campus August 4 open-house announcement was directly accessible at its permanent URL, now stored under the existing source ID. faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Hardee County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school for Hardee County students is Tuesday, August 11, 2026, according to the district's board-approved calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hardee County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 27, 2027 is the final regular student day indicated by the calendar. The fourth quarter ends that day with student early release, followed by a teacher post day on May 28. The PDF does not separately label May 27 as the last day of school.

faqs.question: Which Hardee County schools follow this calendar?
faqs.answer: This is the district's regular student calendar. Hardee County Schools lists Hilltop Elementary, North Wauchula Elementary, Wauchula Elementary, Zolfo Springs Elementary, Hardee Junior High and Hardee Senior High. Families should check their individual schools for bell times and school-specific activities. Separate virtual and adult-education programs may have different schedules.

faqs.question: When is fall break or the homecoming holiday in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: Friday, October 2, 2026 is the Homecoming/Fall Holiday. The district lists no students or staff that day. It is a full one-day holiday, not a week-long fall break, and classes are scheduled to resume Monday, October 5.

faqs.question: Is there school in Hardee County on October 14, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, October 14, 2026 is a staff inservice day with no student classes. The district also confirmed the student closure in an October announcement.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Hardee County Schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 21–29, 2026, including both weekends. Friday, November 20 is an early-release school day. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter or Christmas break in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs from December 19, 2026 through January 3, 2027. January 4 is a separate records day without student classes, so students are scheduled to return January 5.

faqs.question: Do Hardee County students return to school January 4 or January 5?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4 is Records Day with no student classes. Including that day, students have 17 consecutive calendar days off from December 19 through January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Hardee County Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 13–21, 2027. Friday, March 12 is an early-release school day, and students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is there school between spring break and Good Friday in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are scheduled to attend classes Monday, March 22 through Thursday, March 25, 2027. Good Friday on March 26 is a separate holiday, not an extension of spring break.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a school holiday in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a student holiday. Combined with the weekend, students have March 26–28 off and are scheduled to return Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: When are early-release days in Hardee County Schools?
faqs.answer: The five listed student early-release dates are November 20 and December 18, 2026, followed by February 19, March 12 and May 27, 2027. Students attend shortened school days on these dates.

faqs.question: What time do Hardee County students get out on early-release days?

faqs.question: Is February 19, 2027 a no-school day in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: No. February 19 is a student early-release day followed by staff inservice. Students attend a shortened school day rather than having the entire day off.

faqs.question: Which staff or records days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on September 18 and October 14, 2026 for staff inservice, or January 4, 2027 for Records Day. February 19 is different because students attend before early release.

faqs.question: Do Hardee County students have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026 is listed as the Labor Day holiday, with no student classes.

faqs.question: Are Hardee County Schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027 is a school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Do Hardee County Schools close for Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027 is listed as the Presidents Day holiday, with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Hardee County in 2026?
faqs.answer: November 11, 2026 is listed as a progress-report date, not a student holiday, on the district's board-approved calendar. No Veterans Day school closure is shown.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end in Hardee County Schools?

faqs.question: When are student progress reports issued in 2026–2027?

faqs.question: When do Hardee County Schools issue report cards?

faqs.question: When is Hardee County Schools graduation in 2027?
